source_append: `ice:packages/agent/src/harness/skills.ts:11-28` defines the named diagnostic discriminant and fields.
interfaces_append: The diagnostic code is `SkillDiagnosticCode = "file_info_failed" | "list_failed" | "read_failed" | "parse_failed" | "invalid_metadata"`. `SkillDiagnostic` has `type: "warning"`, `code: SkillDiagnosticCode`, `message: string`, and `path: string`; sourced enrichment adds the caller's `source` without changing these fields.

`CompactionErrorCode = "aborted" | "summarization_failed"`. `CompactionError(code, message, cause?: Error)` extends `Error`, sets `name = "CompactionError"` and public `code`, and passes `{ cause }` to the base constructor only when `cause !== undefined`; the cause is not stringified.

`BranchSummaryErrorCode = "aborted" | "summarization_failed"`. `BranchSummaryError(code, message, cause?: Error)` extends `Error`, sets `name = "BranchSummaryError"` and public `code`, and preserves an optional `Error` cause through the base constructor. These are the generic harness helper's returned errors, separate from the coding-agent helper's thrown-error interface.

The completion custom-type constant is `BASH_BACKGROUND_COMPLETED_CUSTOM_TYPE = "bash_background_completed"`. `summarizeShellCommand(command: string): string` applies `trimEnd()`, splits on LF, and returns the first line unchanged for one line or first line plus ` (+N more lines)` for multiple remaining lines. Trailing whitespace and empty trailing lines disappear before counting; leading whitespace is retained, and an all-whitespace input returns the empty first string.

`BashKillInput = Static<typeof bashKillSchema>` projects `Type.Object({ id: Type.String({ description: "Background shell id to stop (for example bash-1)" }) })`; there is no additional runtime algorithm in the alias.

mechanism_append: `printHelp(extensionFlags?: ExtensionFlag[]): void` prints the static usage, package/auth command list, options, examples, environment descriptions and seven builtin tool names through `console.log`. A nonempty extension flag list adds an Extension CLI Flags section in supplied order. Each row uses `--${flag.name}`, appends ` <value>` only for `type === "string"`, pads the flag column to 30 characters, and uses `flag.description ?? "Registered by " + flag.extensionPath`. An absent or empty list adds no section. The printed examples and advertised defaults are presentation strings; they do not validate inputs or prove live provider availability.

interfaces_append: The exact public startup options are `MainOptions { extensionFactories?: InlineExtension[]; globalFirstSettings?: boolean; agentViewBridge?: IceAgentViewBridge }`. The caller's extension factories follow `builtInExtensions` in `main`; the distribution opts into global-first settings and supplies its optional view bridge.
The exported command discriminant is exactly `PackageCommand = "install" | "remove" | "update" | "list"`; `uninstall` is normalized by the parser rather than being an additional union member.
`PackageCommandRuntimeOptions { extensionFactories?: InlineExtension[] }` carries optional inline factories into package-command resource/trust initialization; it adds no new command-line flag.

The source declares `UiMode = TuiMode`, `MarkdownSettings { codeBlockIndent?: string }`, and `WarningSettings { anthropicExtraUsage?: boolean }`. The two-space Markdown fallback and the warning consumer's default are the separate behaviors above; the optional interfaces themselves do not inject values.

source_append: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts:82` declares `TransportSetting = Transport`; this is a type alias of the AI transport contract, with no separate runtime behavior.
`ice:packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts:216` defines `DEFAULT_BASH_AUTO_BACKGROUND_MS = 60_000`, the named default consumed by this setting.

mechanism_append: `getProjectTrustParentPath(cwd)` canonicalizes with the same `normalizeCwd`, obtains `dirname`, and returns `undefined` when the normalized path is already its own parent. The parent-trust option is offered only for a returned parent; its grouped update sets that parent true and removes the current child decision. Session-only options use empty updates and do not persist a decision.

source_append: `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/observe/observe-cognee.ts:98-148` exports `createObserveCogneeSource`; `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/main.ts:929-937` constructs it with the session cwd for the dashboard.
interfaces_append: The factory is `createObserveCogneeSource(options: { cwd: string; configPath?: string; fetch?: typeof fetch }): ObserveCogneeSource`. Its connection is created only on first use, shared through one promise, and reset after a failed initial connection. Auth/unreachable request failures clear the same still-current connection and summary cache.

source_append: The observation integration exports `createObserveCogneeSource` in `ice:packages/coding-agent/src/observe/observe-cognee.ts:98-148`; its lazy connection, recovery and dashboard-specific caches are specified by `OBS-017` and `OBS-018`.
